This document describes **Project Maya**, a local LLM inference stack for running large MoE models on consumer/prosumer hardware. Key technical points:

**Models & Quantization**
- Maya provides its own quantized variants (XS/S/M/L tiers by expert bit-width) of GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, and MiniMax-M3.1-Flash, plus support for community quants (EXL3, unsloth GGUFs).
